EmailTemplate.name: Reminder: Trial Close to Expiration
EmailTemplate.subject: Reminder: {!Account.Name} Trial Close to Expiration
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi,
Your free trial to {!Account.Count_of_Contacts_Receiving_Research__c} user(s) at {!Account.Name} will expire in {!Opportunity.Days_Until_Trial_End__c} days: {!Opportunity.Link}
Account managers are notified 14 and 7 days prior to each trial’s expiration. Sales ops will additionally reach out with one last follow up to make sure extension requests are submitted in a timely manner. Going forward, all trials will be shut off automatically after 90 days and it is the account manager’s responsibility to get approval to extend each trial from Rachel/Justin in advance. Sales ops will extend or turn trials/accounts back on if Rachel/Justin is copied on the request confirming the extension.
If trial is not being extended, trial users will be moved to a marketing campaign list after disablement.
Thanks, SalesOps
